_comment: Owner-directed Great Lakes dune palette. This sand surface treatment pairs with the physical shore-profile bake and dune grass cover; Veilfall keeps its mountain treatment.
_reference: Inspected NPS Sleeping Bear Dunes photo: https://www.nps.gov/slbe/learn/photosmultimedia/index.htm (pale quartz sand, sparse sage/straw beach grass, dark damp waterline); direction only, no photographic pixels shipped.
_comment_bluff: The supplied dune references show continuous sand on steep crests. Reserve exposed mineral for near-vertical surfaces; the graded shore shoulders and most interior dune faces are sand. Full mineral coverage still retains installed albedo, normals and roughness.
_comment_shadow: Gated terrain-only shadow caster offset in metres, limited to 0..0.10 and faded out at Veilfall. Native Gull Rest controlled receiver-01 comparison removed fine self-shadow bands at 0.05 while retaining the trainer contact shadow. Visual terrain/collision and global Sun bias are unchanged. Cross-island/day-night review remains required.
